name: Ethics and professional conduct
description: Acting with integrity under the institute's code: conflicts of interest, confidentiality, client money and the duties owed to clients and the public.
l1: Knows the code of conduct and the duties it sets.
l2: Applies the code in daily work: discloses conflicts, keeps records and handles client information properly.
l3: Resolves difficult ethical situations and advises colleagues on applying the code.
l4: Sits on the institute's standards or disciplinary panels, or writes guidance on professional conduct.

name: Client care
description: Meeting a client's brief: terms of engagement, understanding needs, service standards and complaints handling.
l1: Knows the principles of client care and the terms an engagement sets.
l2: Manages client relationships to agreed terms and resolves concerns.
l3: Advises clients and others on difficult engagements and sets service standards for a team.
l4: Sets client-care standards adopted beyond their own firm.

name: Data management
description: Collecting, storing, securing and retrieving project data within the privacy law of the jurisdiction.
l1: Knows the privacy law and data security principles that apply.
l2: Manages project data to policy and law, with access controls and retention.
l3: Advises on data governance and privacy compliance for complex projects.
l4: Writes data management standards or guidance used across the profession.

name: Financial modelling
description: Building models that show the risk and return of investment and development scenarios.
l1: Knows how a cash flow model is structured and what drives its outputs.
l2: Builds and tests models with sensitivity analysis for real cases.
l3: Reviews others' models and advises on complex scenarios from them.
l4: Sets modelling standards that others adopt, or acts as an expert on financial projections.

name: Investment management
description: Managing assets and portfolios against investment objectives: strategy, performance and risk.
l1: Knows how portfolios are set up and their performance measured.
l2: Manages assets to an investment strategy and reports performance.
l3: Advises on portfolio strategy and is accountable for the results.
l4: Shapes portfolio strategy for major funds or contributes to industry standards.

name: Valuation
description: Valuing assets for their many purposes with the right methods, bases of value and standards.
l1: Knows the purposes of valuation, its methods and the standards that apply.
l2: Prepares valuations and reports to the standards
l3: with a qualified valuer signing them off.
l4: Signs off formal valuations and gives reasoned advice on complex assets.
source: Writes or reviews valuation standards, or trains and assesses other valuers.

name: Capital taxation
description: Capital taxation of assets and the valuations that support it.
l1: Knows the main capital taxes and how assets are valued for them.
l2: Prepares tax valuations and supporting evidence for returns.
l3: Advises on capital tax positions and negotiates with tax authorities.
l4: Acts as an expert in tax disputes or advises on tax policy.

name: Property management
description: Managing property for owners: leases, operating costs, maintenance and reporting.
l1: Knows the owner and occupier relationship and the main management duties.
l2: Manages properties day to day to lease terms and budget.
l3: Advises on complex management issues and leads a management team.
l4: Sets property management standards for large portfolios or the industry.
